name: mcp-adventure
description: An LLM-powered text adventure backed by an MCP game server.

scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U mcp_adventure -d mcp_adventure
scripts.db:init: npm run wait --workspace @mcp-adventure/database && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: npm run reset-schema --workspace @mcp-adventure/database && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration
